source.note: Minimal genre-neutral reference acceptance template for the 2d-shooter pack (genre-pack decoupling, Phase 2). It exercises the required, genre-neutral contract sections (fonts/palette/hud/framing/feel/juice/manifest/win) for a top-down/twin-stick shooter and deliberately OMITS the optional platformer-only sections (platformer/reachability/placement/render/props/physics). The shooter feel section carries the measure-only shooter metrics shipped by the shooter measurement loop; it is a seed for `plan --genre 2d-shooter`, not a hand-tuned shipping contract.

elements.note: Max 3 hearts; lost slot stays as an empty pip so layout never shifts.

camera.note: Static one-screen arena framing (16:9, 256x144 native @ 5x). The arena is read in one screen; no scrolling camera in the reference slice.

playerAnchor.note: Static arena camera — the player anchor is informational (centered), not a per-frame follow target.

fireInputToSpawnLatency.note: fire input onset to projectile spawn; measure-only (aspirational target, not gate-enforced)

hitStop.note: Brief impact freeze on enemy hit/kill.

screenShake.note: Trauma model: small kick on fire and a larger one on hit/kill.

win.note: Win when every reference enemy in the arena is defeated; reaching a zero-enemy state flips GameManager.isWin.

verification.note: Derived from the sections this contract deliberately OMITS (platformer/reachability/placement/props), one gate per omitted section: platform-tiles + tile-render + parallax-motion walk `platformer`, reachability walks `reachability`, placement walks `placement`, prop-purpose walks `props` + `placement`. Same rule promote.ts applies to a promoted GenreContract, and the same set _generic declares. Without this block a WHOLE-GAME verify left the platformer-shaped gates APPLICABLE for a top-down shooter, grading it on parallax layers and platform tiers it was never designed to have. The slice DAG requests none of these six, so nothing here can make a slice unreachable-green.
